blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Continuing the Perception Test challenge series, we organised the fourth edition as a workshop at the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026 in Malmö, Sweden. This edition focused on spatial intelligence and featured four different tracks: unified multiple-choice videoQA and grounded videoQA from the original Perception Test benchmark, alongside two new tracks based on city-scale walking-tour videos (KilometerAudio and KilometerVision). In this report, we describe the new benchmarks used for the city-scale tracks and summarise the winning solutions across all tracks, including a generalist model that competed across all tracks with satisfactory performance. The winning solutions in the newly added city-scale tracks demonstrated that complex spatial and multimodal reasoning can be solved by expensive agentic pipelines, but remains difficult for multimodal models used standalone.
blocks.zh: 继续思考 测试挑战系列,我们在瑞典马尔默举行的2026年欧洲计算机展望会议上作为讲习班组织了第四版。 本版以空间智能为主,主要播放四个不同的曲目: 统一的多选择视频 QA 和禁闭视频 QA来自最初的感知测试基准,与两条基于城市尺度步行图视频(KilometerAudio和KilometerVision)的新曲目并列. 在本报告中,我们描述了城市轨迹所使用的新基准,并总结了所有轨迹的胜负解决办法,包括一种在所有轨迹上竞争、表现令人满意的通论模式。 新增加的城市规模轨道的胜出解决方案表明,复杂的空间和多式联运推理可以通过昂贵的代理管道来解决,但对单独使用的多式联运模型来说仍然是困难的。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Frontier AI models have demonstrated super-human capabilities in multiple areas, from solving Millennium problems in Mathematics ( OpenAI, 2026 ) , to controlling plasma for nuclear fusion reactors with superhuman precision ( Citrin et al., 2024 ) , and writing complex software at speed much higher than humans. Yet, the general perception capabilities of these models are still falling short compared to average humans, especially on spatial understanding tasks. This might not come as a surprise, given that these models are mainly trained with passive internet-scale data, whereas the common dogma states that environment interaction is essential for learning perception ( Poincaré, 2011 ; Held and Hein, 1963 ) .
blocks.zh: 前沿AI模型在多个领域展现出超人的能力,从解决数学中的千年问题(OpenAI,2026)到控制等离子体用于超人精度的核聚变反应堆(Citrin等,2024),并写出比人类快得多的复杂软件. 然而,与一般人类相比,这些模型的一般感知能力仍然不足,特别是在空间理解任务方面。 这也许并不奇怪,因为这些模型主要是以被动的互联网尺度数据培训的,而共同的教条则指出环境互动对学习认知至关重要(Poincaré,2011;Held and Hein,1963)。

blocks.en: In this context, we dedicated the fourth edition of the Perception Test challenge 1 1 1 https://perception-test-challenge.github.io/ to probing spatial intelligence in frontier models across different environment scales. We rely on the original Perception Test benchmark to evaluate small-scale (table-top) spatial capabilities. For large-scale spatial understanding, we leverage the recently introduced KilometerVision benchmark ( Mahendran et al., 2026 ) , together with a newly created benchmark for audio-visual reasoning in large-scale environments; see details in sections 2 and 3 .
blocks.zh: 在这方面,我们把第四版的《感知测试挑战》1 1 https://regision-test-challenge.github.io/专门用于在不同环境尺度上探索前沿模型中的空间情报。 我们依靠最初的感知测试基准来评价小型(表-上)空间能力. 就大规模空间理解而言,我们利用了最近采用的基里姆拉维相基准(Mahendran等,2026年),以及新制定的大规模环境中视听推理基准;详情见第2和3节。

blocks.en: Challenge tracks: The challenge featured four tracks: Unified VideoQA, Grounded VideoQA, KilometerVision, and KilometerAudio. The first two tracks relied on videos from the original Perception Test benchmark, whereas the latter two tracks relied on publicly available Youtube Walking-Tour videos, annotated specifically for each benchmark.
blocks.zh: 挑战轨道 : 挑战包括四道道:统一视频QA、地面视频QA、千米计图像和千米计音频。 前两首曲目依赖于原"感知测试"基准的视频,而后两首曲目则依赖于可公开获得的Youtube Walking-Tour视频,对每个基准都作了特注.

blocks.en: Challenge setup and prizes: The competition was hosted on the EvalAI platform. Each track had a validation and a test phase. The validation servers opened in mid-June 2026, and the test servers became available starting in mid-July (for unified and grounded VQA) and mid-August 2026 (for KilometerAudio and KilometerVision). The submission period closed at the end of August 2026. Participants were required to report the evaluation mode (zero-shot, few-shot, or fine-tuned) and submit a short technical report. Only the test submissions made public on the leaderboard were eligible for awards with monetary prizes, which totalled 22K EUR across tracks. We awarded runner-up and winners in each track, together with a best generalist award for an entry that competed across all tracks with the same backbone and obtained strong performance. We also offered honorary best performance certificates in KilometerVision and KilometerAudio tracks to a team that obtained the best scores in these tracks, but was not eligible for awards due to Google affiliation.
blocks.zh: 挑战设置和奖项: 比赛由EvalAI平台主办. 每道有验证和试验阶段. 验证服务器于2026年6月中旬开通,测试服务器自7月中旬起(用于统一并被禁用VQA)至2026年8月中旬起(用于KilmolAudio和KilmolVision)即可提供. 提交期于2026年8月底结束。 要求参与者报告评价模式(零发、少发或微调)并提交一份简短的技术报告。 只有在领导板上公开的试卷才有资格获得奖金,奖金总额是22K欧元。 我们为每个赛道的赛跑冠军和获奖者颁发了最佳通才奖,奖励的参赛者是同一支主力队伍在所有赛道上竞争并取得优异成绩的球员。 我们还向一支在这些赛道上获得最佳分数的球队提供Kilometer Vision和KilometerAudio赛道的荣誉最佳战绩证书,但由于谷歌隶属关系,没有资格获得奖项.

blocks.en: 2 KilometerVision Benchmark
blocks.zh: 2公里计 远景基准

blocks.en: KilometerVision ( Mahendran et al., 2026 ) is a recent benchmark that probes city-scale spatial capabilities in frontier models using real-world walking tour Youtube videos, up to 10 minutes long, corresponding to about 1KM walking distance. The tasks use multiple-choice videoQA format, with three different task configurations: standard multiple-choice video QA with five text options; multiple-choice video QA where the five options are images (e.g. candidate route maps, see example in Figure 1 ); and multiple-choice video QA where the question includes an image (e.g. a landmark whose distance to the final camera position must be estimated, see example in Figure 2 ). The benchmark includes seven types of questions: landmark recognition, distance to landmark, compass, loop closure, route summary, map trace (with or without text labels on the map), and Euclidean distance. Please check the original publication ( Mahendran et al., 2026 ) for more details about the tasks and data collection.
blocks.zh: Kilometer Vision (Mahendran等, 2026年)是近期使用现实世界行走之旅Youtube视频探测前沿模型中城市规模空间能力的基准,最长可达10分钟,相当于约1KM行走相距. 任务使用多选择视频 QA格式,有三个不同的任务配置:标准多选择视频 QA 有5个文本选项;多选择视频 QA,其中5个选项是图像(例如候选路由图,见图1中的例子);多选择视频 QA,其中问题包括一个图像(例如一个地标,其与最终相机位置的距离必须估算,见图2中的例子). 基准包括了七类问题:地标识别,地标距离,指南针,环路关闭,路由摘要,地图跟踪(地图上有无文字标签),和欧几利得距离. 请检查access-date=中的日期值 (帮助) 原出版物 (Mahendran等,2026年) 关于任务和数据收集的更详细信息.

blocks.en: 3 KilometerAudio Benchmark
blocks.zh: 3公里计 音频基准

blocks.en:
To assess models’ audio-visual capabilities in large-scale environments, we introduce the KilometerAudio benchmark.
This is a novel benchmark, introduced here for the first time.
It aims to test the ability of foundational models, including agentic approaches, to reason about the interlink between audio and visual modalities in very long videos – i.e. videos captured over walking for several kilometers around an urban environment. Natural sounds that are automatically captured in these public YouTube videos include sounds of human-made objects (cars, motorbikes, church bells, etc.), natural sounds (birds chirping and dogs barking), speech as well as acoustic urban pollution. Importantly, the videos are not edited to introduce irrelevant sounds (e.g. overlay music), making them ideal for multimodal reasoning. Due to the nature of walking videos, audio is often caused by an event ‘out of sight’ of the camera.
Reasoning about an in-view visual along with an out-of-view audio as well as the length of the videos make this benchmark particularly unique and challenging.
blocks.zh:
为了评估模型在大规模环境中的视听能力,我们采用了KilomeroAudio基准。
这是一个全新的基准,首次引入于此.
它旨在测试基础模型的能力,包括代理方法,以解释非常长的视频中音频和视觉模式之间的相互联系,即环绕城市环境行走多公里的视频。 这些公开的YouTube视频中自动捕获到的自然声音包括人造物体的声音(汽车,摩托车,教堂钟等),自然声音(鸟鸣和狗叫),语音以及声响的城市污染. 重要的是,这些视频没有经过编辑,以引入不相干的声音(例如上覆音乐),使它们成为多模式推理的理想. 由于行走视频的性质,音频常常是由相机 " 视线外 " 的事件造成的。
由于一个内视和外视音频以及视频长度的原因,这一基准特别独特并具有挑战性。

blocks.en:
Compared to existing audio-video benchmarks, e.g. ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Pătrăucean et al., 2023 ; Fu et al., 2025 ; Xie et al., 2025 ; Chao et al., 2026 ) , KilometerAudio uses significantly longer videos (see Figure 4 for a comparison) and focuses exclusively on audio events.
The test set contains 500 five-option questions over 218 publicly available hour-long Youtube walking-tour videos (1–3 h). Video-MME Long has videos up to 1h long, but only a small fraction of the questions focus on audio events.
blocks.zh:
相较于现有的音频视频基准,如(杨等,2024;Pătrăucean等,2023;傅等,2025;谢等,2025;Chao等,2026),Kilmero-Audio使用长度显著延长的视频(比较见图4),并专门关注音频事件.
测试集包含超过218个公开的小时YouTube步行-tour视频(1–3 h)的500个五选项问题. 视频-MME Long的视频长度可达1h,但只有一小部分的问题侧重于音频事件.

blocks.en: All the questions in KilometerAudio were collected with human raters and checked by our research team. The raters were instructed to identify recognisable sounds in the videos and formulate questions that require both the audio and visual modalities to be answered: identifying sound sources in space, localising or timing audio events, counting them, recognising songs or speech; see Figure 3 . The raters were also required to provide the answers to the questions, together with plausible difficult negative options. The validation split (8 questions on 6 videos) reuses the audio-related questions of the hour-long video QA benchmark of the 2024 and 2025 editions ( Heyward et al., 2024 ) . All test questions are new, and only 3 of the 218 test videos were used in previous editions. No training data are provided, so the track is zero-shot; see Table 1 .
blocks.zh: KilomeroAudio的所有问题都与人类检测器一起收集,并由我们的研究小组检查。 评估员被指示在视频中识别识别出的声音,并提出需要回答的音频和视频模式问题:在空间中识别声音源,定位或计时音频事件,计数,识别歌曲或语音;见图3。 评分员还必须回答这些问题,并提出合理的困难的负面选择。 验证拆分(6个视频的8个问题)再用2024年和2025年版的小时视频QA基准(Heyward等,2024. 所有测试题材均为新题材,前作版本仅使用了218个测试视频中的3个. 未提供培训数据,因此赛道为零;见表1。

blocks.en: We received 1254 test submissions from 120 different teams across the four tracks. As it can be observed in Figure 6 , the performance improved steadily across editions on the unified and grounded videoQA tracks (using videos from the original Perception Test benchmark): from 0.812 (in 2025) to 0.914 top-1 accuracy in unified multiple-choice video QA in 2026, and from 0.497 (in 2025) to 0.664 HOTA in grounded video QA in 2026. In the two new tracks, the best-performing entry (non-eligible for prizes) reached close to perfect performance (0.864 on KilometerAudio and 0.905 on KilometerVision). The best prize-eligible submissions were also very strong, reaching 0.782 top-1 accuracy on KilometerAudio and 0.753 for KilometerVision.
blocks.zh: 我们收到了120支不同队伍提交的1254份测试报告,它们跨越了四道。 如图6所示,在统一和有根据的视频上,各版的表现稳步改善。 QA音轨(使用原"感知测试"基准的视频):2026年统一多选择视频QA中从0.812(2025年)到0.914高一的精度;2026年被禁用视频QA中从0.497(2025年)到0.664 HOTA. 在两条新赛道上,表现最优的入场(无资格获得奖项)接近完美表现(KilomeroAudio上0.864分和KilomeroVision上0.905分). 最佳的获奖提案也非常有力,在KilometerAudio上达到0.782高一的准确度,在KilometerVision上达到0.753高一的准确度。

blocks.en: 5 Challenge Tracks, Results, Awards
blocks.zh: 5 挑战轨道、结果、 奖项

blocks.en: For each track, we summarise the 2026-specific setup, the results, and the awarded methods. Team reports, with author names and affiliations, are linked from the workshop website: https://perception-test-challenge.github.io/ .
blocks.zh: 每个赛道,我们总结2026年的具体设置,结果,以及授予的方法. 与作者姓名和隶属关系有关的小组报告与讲习班网站链接:https://degument-test-challenge.github.io/。

blocks.en: 5.1 Unified multiple-choice video QA
blocks.zh: 5.1 统一的多选择视频QA

blocks.en: Task, data, and metric. These are unchanged from 2025; see Heyward et al. (2026, Sec. 2 and 4.1) . Specifically, the test set combines the 11,528 original 3-option questions with the 1,842 5-option unified questions (point tracking, action ordering, object–action interaction, pretend action), which use visual prompts to recast tracking and temporal localisation as questions; the unified questions have no training split enforcing zero-shot evaluation. The metric is top-1 accuracy.
blocks.zh: 任务、数据和衡量标准。 这些情况与2025年没有变化;见Heyward等人(2026年,第2和第4.1节)。 具体来说,测试集将11,528个最初的3-选项问题与1,842个5-选项的统一问题(点跟踪,动作顺序,对象-动作交互,假想动作)结合起来,这些问题使用可视化的提示来重塑跟踪和时间定位作为问题;统一的问题没有训练分割执行零发评价. 度量衡为最高一等精度.

blocks.en: Baselines: A random baseline scores 0.313 on the test set (chance level 31.5%, i.e. 33.3% on the 3-option and 20% on the 5-option questions, weighted by their counts).
blocks.zh: 基线: 随机基线在测试集上得分为0.313(chance level 31.5%,即3-选项33.3%,5-选项问题20%,按其计数加权).

blocks.en: Table 2 lists the awarded entries compared to the random baseline. The winning team, Njust-KMG, used a question-type-aware weighted ensemble of three models: Qwen3-VL-32B fine-tuned on the Perception Test training set (with a curriculum stage on the hardest question types and option shuffling to reduce position bias), and the Doubao-Seed-2.0-Pro and Gemini 3.1 Pro APIs queried zero-shot with question-type-specific prompts; the ensemble weights are derived from per-type validation accuracy. While the individual models obtain 78–83% on the test set, the ensemble reaches 91.4%. The runner-up, F423, used a single zero-shot model, Doubao-Seed-2.0-Lite, with evidence-first prompting (extracting the visual, temporal, and audio evidence before comparing the options), adaptive frame sampling (1–2 fps depending on the question type), and strict answer validation with at most one re-query, reaching 91.0%. Please check the workshop website for more details on the methods included in the submission reports.
blocks.zh: 表2列出了与随机基线比较的获奖条目。 获胜的球队Njust-KMG使用了三种型号的问题型感应加权组合: Qune3-VL-32B 微调 测试训练集(课程阶段为最难的问题类型和选项打分以降低位置偏差),而杜宝-Seed-2.0-Pro和双子座3.1 Pro APIs用问题类型的特有提示询问零发;综艺权重取自于每个类型的验证精度. 虽然单个型号在测试集中获得78–83%,但综艺节目达到91.4%. 跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑 请查看研讨会网站,了解提交报告所列方法的更详细情况。

blocks.en: Relative to earlier editions (Figure 7 ), the 2026 winner improved significantly on the questions added in 2025 (86.2% vs 65.4% for the best 2025 model) compared to improvement on the original set (92.2% vs 83.7%). This indicates that the reformulated tracking and localisation questions are quickly becoming tractable for current models.
blocks.zh: 相较于更早的版本(图7),2026年胜出者在2025年所加入的问题(最佳2025年模式的86.2%与65.4%相比)上有了显著的改善,而原版的改进(92.2%与83.7%). 这表明,重新设计的跟踪和定位问题正在迅速成为当前模型的可操作性。

blocks.en: Figure 8 breaks the winner’s accuracy down by question type and shows which areas the quasi-solved ( > 95 % >95\% ) and the hardest questions come from. Of the 141 questions, 66 (46.8%) are now quasi-solved, compared with 36 (25.5%) for the 2025 winner on the same questions, and only 2 questions obtain an accuracy of 50% or lower (14 in 2025), both in the Physics area. Physics also dominates the 10 hardest questions (accuracy ≤ 80 % \leq 80\% ; 8 Physics, 1 Spatial reasoning, 1 Abstraction). The remaining errors therefore concentrate on intuitive physics (e.g. judging the temperature of poured water, or predicting outcomes when imagining a change in velocity or friction of an object) rather than on recall or counting.
blocks.zh: 图8按问题类型打破了胜者准确性,并显示准解区( > 95% > 95)和最难解出的问题。 在141个问题中,66个(46.8%)现在已准解析,而2025年得分者在相同问题上为36个(25.5%),只有2个问题获得50%或更低的精度(2025年有14个),两者均在物理领域. 物理学还主导了10个最难的问题(准确性为 ^ 80%\leq 80\%;8物理,1空间推理,1抽象). 因此,剩余的错误集中于直观物理(例如判断倒入水的温度,或者在想象物体的速度或摩擦变化时预测结果),而不是去回顾或计数.

blocks.en: 5.2 Grounded video QA
blocks.zh: 5.2 地面录像QA

blocks.en: Task, data, and metric. These are identical to previous editions ( Heyward et al., 2026 ) : given a video and a question, the model must track the object(s) that answer it, on the same 932 test videos (1,859 questions), evaluated with HOTA ( Luiten et al., 2020 ) . The baseline runs the MDETR detector ( Kamath et al., 2021 ) on the middle frame with the question as query and keeps the detections static throughout the video.
blocks.zh: 任务、数据和衡量标准。 这些版本与之前的版本(Heyward等,2026年)相同: 给一个视频和一个问题,模型必须跟踪答案的对象,在同一932个测试视频(1,859个问题)上,通过HOTA(Luiten等,2020年)评价. 基线将MDETR探测器(Kamath等,2021年)运行在以问题为查询的中框上,并在整个视频中保持探测静态.

blocks.en: Results: Table 3 lists the two awarded entries compared to the baseline. Both solutions use a strong VLM to decide which objects answer the question and a SAM-family model for dense tracking. The winning team, Banana Bats, proposed Gemini-SAM3: Gemini 3.7 Flash, used zero-shot, builds a tracking plan (target identities, visibility intervals, anchor frames and boxes, checked by a critic) and provides sparse boxes at 1 fps; SAM 3 ( Carion and others, 2025 ) , prompted with the anchor boxes, propagates the targets bidirectionally, and its tracks are fused with the sparse Gemini tracks only when they pass reliability checks. A variant of SAM 3 with a small residual head trained for amodal (occlusion-aware) boxes on external data is selected for multi-target questions. The runner-up, Huawei SpaceMind, used GPT-5.6 Sol zero-shot to identify the answer objects and produce complete box tracks, then refined only the box coordinates, never the object identities, using a second independent track, repeated queries on close-up crops, and SAM 2.1 ( Ravi et al., 2025 ) box refinement.
blocks.zh: 结果:表3列出了与基线比较的两个授予条目。 两种解决方案都使用强VLM来决定哪些对象回答问题,并使用SAM-家族模式来进行密集跟踪. 获胜球队香蕉蝙蝠队提出双子座-SAM3:双子座 3.7 Flash,使用"零射",构建跟踪计划(目标身份,能见度间隔,锚框和盒子,由评论家检查),并在1英尺高空提供稀有的盒子;SAM 3(Carion等,2025年)由锚盒所激发,双向宣传目标,而其轨迹只有在通过可靠性检查时才会被稀有的双子座轨道所接通. SAM 3的一个变体,有一个小的残余头被训练成关于外部数据的模式(隐形-意识)盒,是为多目标问题选择的. 跑步者华威SpaceMind使用GPT-5.6 Sol 零发来识别答案对象并产生完整的盒道,再用第二道独立轨迹来精炼出盒道坐标,从不精炼出物体身份,再用特写收成的反复查询,再用SAM 2.1(Ravi等,2025年)箱道精炼.

blocks.en: Figure 9 compares the top 2026 model to the best entries of previous editions: HOTA increased from 0.497 to 0.664, about one third higher, with similar gains in detection (0.479 to 0.654) and association accuracy (0.524 to 0.677). In 2023 the best entry barely exceeded the static baseline (0.063 vs 0.052 HOTA). Only three years later, zero-shot pipelines that pair a VLM with a promptable tracker produce very strong performance, showing the high pace of progress in the field.
blocks.zh: 图9将前2026年的型号与前几期的最佳入围进行对比:HOTA从0.497增加到了0.664,高出了约三分之一,在检测(0.479到0.654)和关联精度(0.524到0.677)上也有类似的收益. 在2023年,最好的条目几乎超过了静态基线(0.063对0.052 HOTA)。 仅仅三年后,将一VLM与可快跑的跟踪器相配的零射入射管就产生了非常强的性能,显示出了该领域的高速进步.

blocks.zh: 表3:测试集的地面视频QA结果.

blocks.en: Figure 9: Baseline vs best results over time in terms of overall HOTA, detection, and association accuracy for the grounded video QA task.
blocks.zh: 图9:基准相对于时间跨度的最佳结果,从总体HOTA、检测和关联准确性的角度来说,是限时的视频QA任务。

blocks.en: 5.3 KilometerVision
blocks.zh: 5.3 公里计 愿景

blocks.en: Task, data, and metric: The model needs to answer 5-way multiple-choice questions that can have different configurations as mentioned in section 2 . The challenge test set contains 986 questions on 54 walking-tour video segments, spanning six question types: landmark recognition and distance to landmark (147), compass (146), loop closure (112), route summary (147), start–end Euclidean distance (150), and map trace with or without text labels on the map (284 questions); see Table 4 . No training data are provided. The evaluation metric is top-1 accuracy over the five options.
blocks.zh: 任务、数据和衡量标准: 该模型需要回答5向多选择的问题,如第2节所提及,这些问题可以有不同的配置. 挑战测试集包含54个行走图视频段的986个问题,涉及6个问题类型:标志性识别和距离地标(147个)、罗盘(146个)、环闭路(112个)、路线摘要(147个)、起点-终点欧几利得距离(150个)和地图上是否有文字标签(284个问题);见表4。 没有提供培训数据。 评价的衡量尺度是五种选择的第一准确度。

blocks.en: Table 4: Splits of the KilometerVision track.
blocks.zh: 表4:千米视差轨道的分块。

blocks.en: Baselines: A random baseline obtains 0.196 on the test set (expected chance level 0.20).
blocks.zh: 基线: 随机基准在测试集(预期概率水平0.20)上得到0.196.

blocks.en:
Results: The results are included in Table 5 and Figure 10 . The top solutions combine a VLM for perception and world-knowledge grounding with explicit geometric estimation. The winning team, ohmyyuan, proposed evidence-log video agents: Gemini 3.7 Flash builds a timestamped log of street names, heading changes, and landmarks from frame montages and keyframes, and answers with a family-specific playbook; self-consistency over several sessions is combined with deterministic estimators (optical-flow yaw odometry and visual place recognition) that can override the majority vote, and an independent verifier re-solves questions without a clear majority. The runner-up, Huawei SpaceMind, combined GPT-5.6 Sol for semantic reasoning with a metric camera path reconstructed with VGGT ( Wang et al., 2025 ) and a metric-depth model; question-specific solvers (summed yaw for compass questions, start–end displacement for distances, and route-shape matching for map questions) decided 642 of the 986 answers. The CloudAI-evolve team, which was not eligible for a prize, obtained the best overall score (0.905) and was highlighted as the best-performing entry. Their approach tackled the task with an agentic pipeline with unlimited token budget that
explored the validation set and a small fraction
(about 10%) of the unlabelled test questions to learn a strategy for solving the task on the full test set. The strategy involved calling metric 3D reconstruction models (VGGT-omega), object-size-based scale estimation tools, and grounding the videos on the map.
blocks.zh:
结果:结果载于表5和图10。 顶端解决方案结合了用于感知和世界知识基础的VLM与明确的几何估计. 胜出团队Ohmyyuan提出了证据-log视频代理:双子座 3.7 Flash从帧相和键框中构建了时间标注的街道名称日志,标题变化和地标,并以家庭特有的游戏本进行解答;几会期间的自相一致性与决定性判断器(光学-流线odometry和视觉位置识别)结合,可以压倒多数选票,独立核查器重新解决了问题,而没有明确的多数. 跑步者Huawei SpaceMind将GPT-5.6 Sol语义推理与由VGGT(Wang等人,2025年)重建的一道平面相机路径和一道平面相机模型结合起来;特定问题解答者(罗盘问题的假定yaw;距离的起始-结束迁移;地图问题的路由-形状相配)决定了986个答案中的642个。 CloudAI-evolve球队没有资格获得奖项,获得了最佳总分(0.905分)并被强调为最佳入球. 他们的做法是用一种具有无限象征性预算的代理管道来处理这项任务。
探索验证集和一小部分
(约10%)无标签的测试问题,学习解决全测试集任务的战略. 该战略涉及调用公制3D重建模型(VGGT-omega)、基于对象大小的尺度估计工具,以及将视频放入地图。

blocks.zh: 表5:千分位计图像结果。

blocks.en: Figure 10: Top-5 public test results (top-1 accuracy) in KilometerAudio (top) and KilometerVision (bottom), including the best-performing entry, CloudAI-evolve.
blocks.zh: 图10:KilometerAudio(上)和KilometerVision(下)的Top-5公开测试结果(上至一精度),包括表现最好的条目CloudAI-evolve.

blocks.en: 5.4 KilometerAudio
blocks.zh: 5.4 测高仪

blocks.en: Task description: In the KilometerAudio task, the model receives a full hour-long walking-tour video, including its audio track, together with a question and five possible answers, out of which only one is correct. The questions require processing both the visual and the audio track of the video, e.g. identifying sounds, understanding speech, or correlating audio events with visual content, possibly through multi-hop reasoning.
blocks.zh: 任务描述 : 在"KilomeroAudio"任务中,该模型接收了全小时行走的视频,包括它的音频轨道,以及一个问题和五个可能的答案,其中只有一个是正确的. 这些问题需要同时处理视频的视觉和音频轨迹,例如识别声音,理解语音,或将音频事件与视觉内容相关联,可能通过多跳推理.

blocks.en: Metric: The evaluation metric is top-1 accuracy, i.e. the percentage of questions where the predicted option (1 out of 5) matches the ground truth.
blocks.zh: 度量 : 评价的衡量标准是最高-1的准确度,即预测的选项(5个中的1个)与地面真相相符的问题的百分比。

blocks.en: Baselines: A random baseline obtains 0.174 on the test set (expected chance level 0.20).
blocks.zh: 基线: 随机基准在测试集(预期概率水平0.20)上得到0.174.

blocks.en: Results: The results are included in Table 6 and Figure 10 . The winning team, IUCV, proposed AVRA, a training-free audio-visual reasoning agent built on Gemini 3.7 Flash. For each video, a question-independent index is pre-computed with frozen models: audio-event scores for 447 AudioSet classes from BEATs ( Chen et al., 2023 ) , object detections, and multilingual OCR. At test time, a fresh agent session localises a few candidate time windows from the index, inspects the raw audio and video directly, keeps an explicit evidence log, and derives an answer before reading the options. The runner-up, WW11, proposed a zero-shot tool-using agent in which Gemini 3.1 Pro plans the search and reasons over at most 48 frames or crops per question, using offline indexes of timestamped speech transcripts (Whisper) and CLAP-based sound-event retrieval, and an audio model (Qwen3-Omni) to verify short audio excerpts; an answer is changed only when at least two independent modalities agree. The CloudAI-evolve team obtained again the best overall score (0.864) with a similar agentic pipeline as in the KilometerVision track, but using signal-processing tools instead of 3D reconstruction, to compile a strategy for solving the tasks; Gemini models were used for all reasoning steps. More details can be found on the challenge website.
blocks.zh: 结果:结果见表6和图10。 获奖球队IUCV提出AVRA,一个基于双子座3.7 Flash的无培训视听推理代理. 对于每部视频,先用被冷冻的模型预先计算出一个问题独立的索引:BEATs(Chen等,2023)的447个AudioSet类的音频事件分数,对象检测,以及多语言的OCR. 在测试时间,一个新鲜的代理会话从索引中本地化了几个候选的时间窗口,直接检查了原始的音频和视频,保持了明确的证据日志,并在读取选项前得到答案. 跑步者WW11提出零镜头工具使用代理,双子座 3.1 Pro在每题最多48个帧或收成中规划搜索和理由,使用时间戳语音记录誊本(Whisper)和CLAP基于声音事件检索的离线索引,并使用音频模型(Qune3-Omni)来验证短音频节录;只有在至少两个独立模式达成一致时,才能改变答案. CloudAI-Evolution团队再次以与Kilometer Vision赛道相类似的干线管获得了最佳整体分数(0.864),但使用信号处理工具而不是3D重建,来汇编解决任务的战略;所有推理步骤都使用双子座模型. 详见挑战网站.

blocks.en: Table 6: KilometerAudio results. † Best-performing entry, not eligible for a prize; see text.
blocks.zh: 表6:成绩最佳,无资格获得奖项;见正文。

blocks.en: 5.5 Best Generalist award
blocks.zh: 5.5 联合国 最佳将军奖

blocks.en: The Best Generalist award was received by Wind_Rain_Tower team, who submitted to all four tracks with a single training-free approach. The Qwen3.8-Max model makes every final answer and box decision, without task-specific detectors, trackers, or geometry solvers. Only a separate speech-recognition model is used to transcribe the audio for KilometerAudio as the model cannot process audio natively. The results of the generalist model were: 0.896 top-1 in multiple-choice video QA (5th place, 98% relative to the top solution), 0.465 HOTA in grounded video QA (13th place, 69% of top), 0.604 in KilometerVision (9th place, 80% of top), and 0.506 in KilometerAudio (22nd place, 65% of top). Although the model trailed behind the per-track winners, this is the first submission across the four editions that shows a unified model with satisfactory performance across all the tracks, giving hope that a complete perception model is within reach.
blocks.zh: 最佳通才奖由Wind_Rain_Tower团队获得,后者以单一的无训练方式向全部四道赛道递交. Qwen3.8-Max模型会做出每一个最终的答案和箱决,没有任务特定的探测器,跟踪器,或者几何解析器. 仅使用单独的语音识别模型来为KilomeroAudio翻译音频,因为该模型无法在本地处理音频。 通论模式的结果有:多选择视频QA的0.896上1分(第5名,相对于顶部溶液的98%),被禁视频QA的0.465分(第13名,最高的69%),Kilomerovision的0.604分(第9名,最高的80%),KilomeroAudio的0.506分(第22名,最高的65%). 虽然模式跟随每道胜出者,但这是四个版本的第一个提交,在所有轨道上都显示一个能令人满意表现的统一模式,给人希望,一个完整的感知模式能够实现.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: The Fourth Perception Test challenge attracted a record number of submissions (1254 test submissions) from 120 teams across four tracks. Except for the Grounded VideoQA track, the performance on the remaining three tracks almost saturated ( > 80 % >80\% accuracy). This is remarkable, especially given that two of the tracks, the city-scale tracks, have been run this year for the first time.
blocks.zh: 第四个观念 测试挑战吸引了来自四道120支队伍的创记录数量(1254份测试申请)。 除了有底片的视频 QA音轨,其余三道的性能几乎饱和( > 80%>80QQ). 这很出人意料,特别是考虑到今年有两条轨道,即城市尺度轨道首次运行.

blocks.en: Almost all top solutions were zero-shot agentic pipelines built around proprietary or open-source VLMs (Gemini, GPT, Doubao-Seed, Qwen), often combined with ensembling or self-consistency metrics. Among the awarded entries, only the unified multiple-choice winner fine-tuned a model on the Perception Test training data. The best performing methods in the new city-scale tracks relied on expensive and slow agentic tool use, audio indexing, or explicit geometric reconstruction, but obtained almost perfect performance. In contrast, the Best Generalist entry, which used a single multimodal model for all tasks, stayed close to the winners on multiple-choice video QA, but trailed behind on the city-scale tracks. In conclusion, large-scale audio-visual and spatial reasoning can be solved by systems that orchestrate models with explicit tools, but remains an open problem for multimodal models used standalone.
blocks.zh: 几乎所有顶部溶液都是围绕专有或开源的VLM(Gemini,GPT,Doubao-Seed,Quen)所建造的零射出剂管,经常会与全能或自相容的度量衡结合. 在被授予的条目中,只有统一的多选择取胜者在"感知测试"培训数据上微调出一个模型. 新的城市尺度轨道中的最佳表现方法依赖于昂贵而缓慢的代理工具使用,音频索引,或明显的几何重建,但获得了几乎完美的表现. 相形之下,"最佳通识"条目在所有任务中都使用单一多模式模式,在多选择视频QA上与获奖者保持相近,但在城市尺度轨道上落后. 总之,大规模视听和空间推理可以通过以明确工具协调模型的系统来解决,但对于单独使用的多模式模型来说,仍然是一个公开的问题。
